title: Normalization of sections projections and finite scalar Hom-zero
statement: For a calculus S and resolution coherence D [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], define CoefficientDerivedSystemProjectionModels S D by two independent equations. (1) For every derived system M and n, the composite of S.globalLimit at M, the actual nth mapping-limit projection and D.systemSectionsEvaluation at M equals integral sections of the actual total-limit projection of M followed by D.scalarSections at its nth evaluation. This does not involve internal Hom or gamma. (2) For every integral P, finite M and n, apply integral sections to the evaluation-defined finite enriched scalar adjunct, then D.scalarSections. Its H-zero action, under coefficientIntegralHomEquiv and coefficientFiniteHomEquiv [def-coef-hom-zero-cycle-class], is exactly the inverse of the finite scalar extension/restriction adjunction Hom bijection. This does not involve any system limit, reduction-evaluation transport or gamma. Both clauses are propositions about the existing actual comparisons; this definition chooses no data.
